summary: Season 12 (2025/26) Porsche 99X Electric, team renamed Porsche Formula E Team: TAG Heuer stepped back from title partner to timing partner, so no front sponsor. Porsche lists eight partners - Mobil 1, TDK, LOCTITE, TAG Heuer, PUMA (teamwear), Synopsys (formerly Ansys), NetApp, Cato Networks - all recorded as partner.
